source_title: Where to Buy Engagement Rings Online, From Classic Cuts to Sustainable Picks

Summer may still be the most popular time of year to get married, but these days, wedding season extends across all four seasons , with people saying “I do” during the holidays, during the first blooms of Spring and every month in between. Similarly, engagements are taking place throughout the year, with the best time to pop the question seemingly just when you know it’s right.
Take it from Travis Kelce, who popped the question to Taylor Swift in the dead of summer , or Tom Holland and Zendaya, who got engaged in peak winter months . The old adage of waiting for Valentine’s Day? Consider that thrown out the window, along with old ways of buying a ring too. Since an engagement ring is often the most significant piece of investment jewelry one will ever purchase, it’s understandable that finding the perfect one can be quite challenging. While shopping for the ring in person is a great option, we’re fortunate to live in an age where many reputable retailers make it possible to buy engagement rings online. Want to know the best places to buy a ring online? Here’s what you need to know.
Before diving into our top places to shop (and some of our favorite engagement ring styles), there are a few things to know about shopping for this special ring online.
“When trying to find the right size, you can buy an inexpensive ring sizer tool online or print a ring size chart to wrap around your finger, which will give you a great idea on what size is best,” advises Kylie Bee, the Merchandise Lead of Fine Jewelry at Quince . “However, if you need to be discreet, I recommend borrowing a ring they already wear. Ideally it would be a ring they wear on their left or right ring finger, or middle finger, to get as close as possible to the correct size (as all your fingers are different sizes). You can place it on a piece of paper and use a pencil to circle around the inside, and then measure the diameter of the circle you drew. If you’re using this method,” Bee says, “you should make sure to select an engagement ring style that is easily sizable up/down a full to half size. A representative can confirm if the style you select is sizable and by how much.”
“When it comes to picking the right style, before choosing a ring, consult trusted friends and family first,” Bee recommends. “They might know her style or have access to a Pinterest board with inspiration. The most important aspects of the ring to look for clues on, are about her preferred diamond shape, carat weight and metal color. Also try to find out if she prefers natural or lab-grown diamonds . This way, you can balance her tastes with your budget for the perfect ring.” Lastly when making an investment online, Bee urges you to read the fine print first. “Understanding the return policy and warranty is key when investing in something as meaningful as an engagement ring.”
Now that you feel a little more prepared for your special purchase, read on for the online engagement ring retailers that we’re definitely saying “I do” to.
Blue Nile Riviera Pavé Diamond Engagement Ring in 14k White Gold
Classic and simple yet highly customizable, Blue Nile prides itself on quality and presentation. And given the retailer’s combination of craftsmanship and competitive pricing, it secures our top award for best value for your money.
All diamonds are ethically sourced, and all engagement rings arrive in a deluxe ring box within an elegant presentation box ready for your proposal. The presentation box also secures your appraisal certificate and diamond grading report. Loose diamonds are presented in a velvet lined diamond case that securely holds the stone.
Blue Nile offers financing, free engraving and a lifetime warranty. What we like: Blue Nile has the widest selection of engagement rings online right now, with various sizes, styles and cuts for every personality and budget. Like all Blue Nile’s inventory, the best-seller above is also available in rose gold, yellow gold (both 14k and 18k) and platinum.
From everyday fine jewelry to unique engagement styles , Kinn Studio really is synonymous with “cool girl.” Fresh off a three-part collaboration with Prince Tennis , Kinn continues to grow its bridal assortment with pieces that are equal parts timeless and on trend.
Kinn is one of our favorite picks for chunkier gold styles, like cigar bands, thick bezel settings and, of course, the ribbed Solis Ring pictured above. It certainly doesn’t have the largest selection but that’s kind of why we love it: Every piece feels perfectly intentional.
Angara Princess Diana Inspired Blue Sapphire Engagement Ring With Halo
For made-to-order natural and lab-grown gemstone engagement styles, look no further than Angara . While the retailer certainly thrives in the classic diamond department (for everyday fine jewelry and engagement rings alike), its highly customizable and striking selection of sapphire, emerald, ruby and other gemstone pieces is truly what sets the retailer apart.
Given how personalized Angara’s jewelry can be, these rings can easily be tailored to a wide range of budgets: from a few hundred dollars to $100,000-plus. Create your dream ring at Angara with guidance from 24/7 customer assistance.

Plum Diamonds Three Stone Marquise Engagement Ring
Plum Diamonds is a women-owned and operated business that only works with lab-grown diamonds because they believe that they’re a better bang for your buck — not to mention more eco-friendly.
Plum Diamonds offers a selection of diamonds, side views, bands, metal colors and engraving, as well as financing, and free resizing and polishing for life. Rings are crafted from scratch in 15 to 17 business days.
As you can see by the in-store photo, we headed to Jean Dousset ‘s luxurious West Hollywood boutique to confirm the rumors were true: The new Claire Collection ‘s center stone does in fact look like it’s floating on air. This is thanks to Dousset’s thinnest prongs yet, designed to disappear around the diamond (especially evident with colorless diamonds set in platinum or 18k white gold).
Regardless of ring choice, Jean Dousset promises an ultra-luxe experience (both online and in store). After all, Dousset is the great-great-grandson of none other than Louis Cartier. Enough said.
Mejuri ‘s pieces are handcrafted from precious materials like solid gold, sterling silver and diamonds — never brass or steel. Although customization options are limited to metal colors (yellow gold or silver), and engraving (free but not eligible for returns), Mejuri’s rings are chic and unique enough to be a fool-proof choice but don’t just take our word for it: These rings have been seen on everyone from Hollywood stars to top influencers.
Quince Diamond Emerald Petite Pave Engagement Ring
Quince believes that everyone should have access to nice things, which is why they keep prices low by using a factory-direct model that cuts out the supply-chain middlemen and reduces costs. We love their chic assortment of lab-grown diamond engagement rings that range between $900 and $5,000.
They also offer financing and a generous return policy. “At Quince, all engagement rings can be returned or exchanged within 60 days, and we offer a limited lifetime warranty for peace of mind,” reveals Kylie Bee, Quince’s Merchandise Lead of Fine Jewelry.
Catbird ‘s debut line of engagement rings, The Swans , is described by the brand as “elegantly modern – instant heirloom engagement rings with classic lines and proportions. Each ring couples flawlessly with a multitude of wedding bands; shape shifting in mood and era depending upon the pairing.”
Made to last a lifetime, the collection is set and hand-finished in their Williamsburg, Brooklyn studio by their expert team of in-house jewelers. Each ring is made with 100 percent recycled solid 14k gold or platinum. Financing is available, as well as two-day delivery and 10-day returns or exchanges. Catbird also offers complimentary virtual or IRL appointments to help you pick out your perfect piece.
Vrai The Three Stone Oval Engagement Ring
Vrai ‘s lab-grown diamonds are crafted from greenhouse gas crystallized in their foundry in America using zero-emission river energy. Once crystallized, the greenhouse gas can no longer go make the atmosphere reflect heat and warm the planet. What that means: each carat helps to save the climate.
Select your shape, carat, metal and band. Full customization available . All rings are made-to-order. Lifetime warranty and value guarantee.
MiaDonna offers premium lab-grown diamonds attainable for all. Each ring showcases stunning brilliance, thoughtful design, and unmatched quality. Select from a variety of diamonds, metals and sizes. Complimentary engraving is available.
Financing available. Shop with confidence thanks to their lifetime warranty, 60-day returns and 90-day complimentary ring resizing.
